subject: English
question_text: Complete the text with suitable prepositions.
stimulus: Patriotism is a noble quality. A man bereft (a) ----- patriotism is hated by all. His memory sinks (b) ----- oblivion. People feel shy to call (c) ----- him. They don't mourn (d) ----- his death. We all should do away (e) ----- this bad quality.
guide_solution: Use of prepositions: (a) of; (b) into; (c) in; (d) over; (e) with.
